en-US.HybridStopIsland.title: Hybrid Stop
en-US.HybridStopIsland.description: A hybrid between the <gl>Immediate Stop</gl> and the <gl>Wait Stop</gl>. Waits at a station until 1 floor of 1 wagon is completely finished exchanging.
en-US.research.HybridStop.title: Hybrid Train Stop
en-US.research.HybridStop.description: Unlocks a new <gl>Train Stop</gl>, where trains will always stop and only leave when 1 floor of 1 wagon is completely finished exchanging.
